pass: Backs down: does not attack or defy him, and agrees to keep to his forest, civilly or stiffly. No sincere remorse and no real promise to change beyond what is forced out of him.

self.label: a slender elf with long blond hair in a ponytail and cold blue eyes, in fine green robes
self.name: Velas

beliefs.label: Gorm, a dragon god in human shape, a tall black-haired man in a dark coat, power rolling off him

earlier: Velas made himself immortal: he is the first elf, and the elves are his people. Everything he did nearly destroyed the world.
Just now a god remade the world with a new System of levels and skills. Gorm, the strongest of the dragons, is one of its guardians, and could kill Velas with ease.

zones.name: sacred grove
zones.look: a quiet grove at the heart of the elf forest, a shimmering barrier visible between the trees

zones.name: elf village
zones.look: tree houses and white stone paths

seen.label: Gorm, a dragon god in human shape, a tall black-haired man in a dark coat, power rolling off him
seen.activityLook: standing between the trees, arms folded, looking down at him

dialogue.spoken: The System runs now. You will stay inside your forest and behave, Velas. One more scheme against it and I end you myself. There will be no second warning.
